title: Student Survey Advisory Group Member
bio: Jay Patel is a freshman at Harvard College studying Economics and Global Health & Health Policy. He is originally from Los Angeles, California and currently lives in Weld Hall. In addition to serving on the Student Survey Advisory Group, he is in the Harvard College Consulting Group and conducts research at the Graduate School of Education. He believes that the Student Survey Advisory Group is key to boosting survey uptake rates, leading to lasting impact and change across campus.
